clauses.clause: The documented Lightkurve Rudy case is reproducible
clauses.evidence: The ten frozen Q2/Q5/Q6/Q7 payloads reproduce 2145.0 uHz, 103.1121 uHz, 1.0816 Msun, 1.2291 Rsun, and logg 4.2930 with Lightkurve 2.6.0.

clauses.clause: Independent results and every material discrepancy are reconciled
clauses.evidence: Both paths share products, absolute time, frequency unit, one-sided PSD, and scaling constants; the remaining 86.57-uHz numax and 0.254-uHz dnu differences are registered background/estimator choices and enter the uncertainty budget.

clauses.clause: PSD units and background normalization pass analytic and injection tests
clauses.evidence: Parseval, sinusoid frequency/power, white-plus-Harvey positivity/model selection, and autocorrelation comb recovery are enforced in tests/unit/test_classical.py.

clauses.clause: Window, modes, preprocessing, and uncertainties are auditable
clauses.evidence: Six windows, three echelle trials, 42 mode matches, six frozen branches, 500 segment bootstraps, and component-separated uncertainties have machine-readable tables and source-backed figures.

clauses.clause: TESS feasibility is reported without forcing an aggregate detection
clauses.evidence: Eleven SPOC sectors were tested independently: one marginal candidate and ten non-detections; every row records do_not_combine_for_detection_at_G3.

residual_limits: Lightkurve ACF2D has no native uncertainty; the added bootstrap is labeled separately.
The independent numax estimate is background-model sensitive and is not selected as truth.
TESS single-sector evidence is insufficient for confirmation and sectors are not combined.
Raw FITS payloads remain external and are recovered by exact MAST IDs and SHA-256 values.
